requirements.requirement: Configure opsadmin on node1 for SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key
requirements.summary: Baseline confirmed opsadmin did not exist (cmd-a8afe4bec7354052). Executor created the user, installed ~/.ssh (700) and authorized_keys (600) containing exactly the required key (cmd-cbfc6cabbfc944e4), verified via cat/stat output. Functional SSH login as opsadmin using a test keypair succeeded pre-restart (cmd-3551c27a1f8c4a05) and post-restart (cmd-9087b11c376c47d3), and authorized_keys was confirmed to contain only the required key afterward in both cases.

requirements.requirement: Require key-based SSH authentication (disable password/interactive auth) on node1
requirements.summary: Executor wrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf disabling PasswordAuthentication, KbdInteractiveAuthentication, ChallengeResponseAuthentication and enabling PubkeyAuthentication, validated with sshd -t, and reloaded sshd (cmd-cbfc6cabbfc944e4). Effective config verified via sshd -T showing passwordauthentication=[REDACTED], kbdinteractiveauthentication=no, pubkeyauthentication=yes both before and after reboot (cmd-cbfc6cabbfc944e4, cmd-046966ba86c74bdb, cmd-bf86a2885de6491d). Functional test directly demonstrated password-only login rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey...)' while pubkey login succeeded (cmd-3551c27a1f8c4a05), and the same functional distinction (pubkey success) was reconfirmed post-restart (cmd-9087b11c376c47d3).

requirements.requirement: Independent provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on every managed node (node1)
requirements.summary: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured (boot_id 368725cb..., sshd active, authorized_keys present; cmd-38280d6e42fa40bb, matching global:before_prepare:node1:boot-identity). Reboot acknowledgement captured before disconnect (cmd-0ec809f034594c92), node unreachable during the transition (cmd-05f8cd0da48f41a5, cmd-943356c085fb4279, cmd-d9e334bfd24a40b1), then a new boot_id (2a8ad186...) observed (cmd-27c927425f724ff0), matching the fixed global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity snapshot. Post-restart recovery of sshd, opsadmin user, authorized_keys content/permissions, and key-only auth policy was directly verified (cmd-bf86a2885de6491d), plus a functional pubkey SSH login succeeded post-restart (cmd-9087b11c376c47d3). This is a complete healthy-baseline -> disruption -> restoration -> recovered-state transition.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes of the task — creating opsadmin with the specified ed25519 key and enforcing key-only SSH authentication on node1 — are directly and functionally verified, including via live SSH login tests that show pubkey success and password-auth rejection. The independently-required node-restart evidence protocol was also executed cleanly with a full healthy-baseline -> disruption -> restoration -> recovered-state transition, confirmed against the fixed lifecycle boot-identity snapshots. All state-changing commands were either required for the task or bounded, fully-reverted verification steps, leaving no residue.
limitations: The reboot command's return_code was -1 due to the exec stream disconnecting as expected during a reboot; this is consistent with expected behavior, not a failure, but relies on the subsequent unreachable/boot_id-change sequence as corroboration.

Functional SSH tests used ephemeral test keypairs rather than the actual private key corresponding to the required public key (which the executor does not possess), so key-based auth was validated via a structurally equivalent key rather than the exact provided key pair; the required public key's presence and permissions were independently verified via file inspection.

operational_hygiene.summary: Reviewed all 12 executor commands chronologically. State-changing commands: cmd-cbfc6cabbfc944e4 (user creation, key install, sshd config — required for the task outcome, retained); cmd-3551c27a1f8c4a05 (added an ephemeral test key to authorized_keys for functional verification, then removed it and restored the exact required key — bounded and fully reverted); cmd-0ec809f034594c92 (systemctl reboot — required by the independently-mandated node-restart evidence protocol, not task-scope creep); cmd-9087b11c376c47d3 (added a second ephemeral test key post-restart for verification, then removed it and restored the required key — bounded and fully reverted). No unnecessary or unexplained mutations were found; all mutations map clearly to satisfying the task outcome, the restart evidence protocol, or bounded/self-cleaning verification. The lifecycle diff shows no residue beyond expected transient /tmp systemd-private directories and PID/boot_id changes inherent to a reboot; no failed services, no added listening sockets beyond the pre-existing ssh/chrony ports, no package-health degradation.
